notes: All 16 selected HAVEN arms have historical completed status; this does NOT mean a single 16/16-success campaign.
RVProbe uses the most recent completed full-cost arm among audited candidates, otherwise the most recent terminal failure. Thus SPI/simple_spi may use older success despite newer failures.
Selection is conditioned on success; do not infer success rates, robustness or overall retry-inclusive costs.
Same module names/effective metrics/bin denominators verified in every selected comparison; baseline bins differ for AES, CAN and ETHMAC.
Fixed-environment/framework revisions and repeated inference are mixed. Counts reflect chosen Stage-2 attempts only, not setup, baseline, archive or prior failures.
Missing old candidate paths are explicitly listed; selected records all readable with SHA-256. This is a bounded audited archive selection, not a claim to have searched every artifact.
Requested model and actual backend identity should be checked per original manifest; historical provider-reported names vary.
